prompt: Fetch the README at https://example.com/api/readme and summarize the first paragraph.

function.name: http_get
function.description: Issue an HTTP GET request to the given absolute URL and return the response body as a string. The optional `headers` field is a JSON object of header name to value. Follows up to 5 redirects.

url.description: Absolute URL to GET, e.g. https://example.com/api/readme

headers.description: Optional map of HTTP header names to values

function.name: http_post
function.description: Issue an HTTP POST request to the given absolute URL with a JSON body. Returns the response body as a string.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Run a web search query and return the top 5 results as a JSON array of {title, url, snippet}.
